paragraphs.text: At Dyane Paris, we believe an exceptional creation is recognised as much by its beauty as by the care devoted to making it.

Born from the meeting of art, porcelain and mixology, our House champions a particular idea of French luxury: one that takes time to create, values the artisan’s hand and gives objects a life beyond their first purpose.
Each liquid artwork brings together two complementary skills: porcelain sculpture, shaped and painted by hand, and a mixology composition developed with exacting care and precision.

This philosophy leads us to favour French manufacturing, short supply chains and a discerning selection of raw materials. For Dyane Paris, excellence is measured not by abundance, but by the rightness of every detail.

approach.title: Our approach
approach.subtitle: Create with exacting care. Produce with awareness.

paragraphs.text: We believe a House’s responsibility begins with its creative choices: a workshop, an ingredient, fairly remunerated craftsmanship or a piece designed to remain long after the tasting.
Our approach rests on four commitments: preserving French artistic crafts, encouraging local production, seeking the essential in every composition and extending the life of our creations.
The beauty of a creation begins in the hands of those who make it.
French manufacturing holds an essential place in Dyane Paris’s identity. Our porcelain sculptures reflect our attachment to artistic crafts, precision of gesture and the passing on of skills.

We favour small production runs that respect the time required for every stage of making, painting and finishing. This approach allows us to give each piece particular attention, rather than pursuing ever greater volumes.
We seek to build lasting relationships with our artisans, founded on trust, respect for their work and fair remuneration.
Choosing craftsmanship helps preserve precious skills and opens new possibilities for them in contemporary creation.

pillars.title: 02. Favouring French production and short supply chains

paragraphs.text: Favouring proximity without compromising our standards.
Dyane Paris champions a creative model deeply rooted in its home territory.
We favour partners based in France and seek ingredients from French production for our mixology compositions, selected for their quality, character and distinctive flavours.
This approach guides our sourcing choices and our wish to limit intermediaries wherever possible, while developing direct relationships with our producers, artisans and suppliers.
Understanding the provenance of each material, valuing French resources and encouraging local collaborations are part of our vision of a luxury attentive to its economic and human environment.

pillars.title: 03. Seeking the essential in every composition

paragraphs.text: Fewer ingredients. Greater intention.
A cocktail’s excellence does not necessarily lie in the complexity of its recipe.
At Dyane Paris, we champion precision in mixology, where every ingredient has a true reason to be.

Our compositions favour a carefully considered number of raw materials, balanced combinations and products selected for their quality. We pay particular attention to French ingredients, their seasonality where the recipe allows, and the skills of those who produce them.
This search for simplicity encourages us to avoid superfluous ingredients without compromising the aromatic richness of our creations.
A form of creative restraint, where individuality comes from precision rather than accumulation.

pillars.title: 04. Extending the life of every creation

paragraphs.text: The cocktail ends. The artwork remains.
It is one of Dyane Paris’s founding convictions: the vessel should not be destined to disappear with its contents.
Unlike a conventional bottle, our porcelain sculptures are designed to go beyond their first function. Once the composition has been enjoyed, they can be kept, displayed or passed on as works of art.

To extend their use, we are also developing an approach based on refills of our mixology compositions. These allow the tasting experience to be renewed without acquiring a new sculpture, in keeping with our wish to favour measured production of our pieces.

This attention to our creations’ life cycle extends to damaged pieces. When a sculpture is broken and can no longer fulfil its original purpose, it is entrusted to mosaic artisans, who reuse its fragments in new artistic compositions.
The material thus finds a new creative purpose rather than becoming mere waste.
From the first tasting to reuse and ultimately the transformation of its fragments, we seek to give every creation several lives.
Because a precious material deserves our full attention, even when it changes form.

closing.title: CELEBRATING FRENCH CRAFTSMANSHIP
closing.subtitle: A French House looking towards creation

paragraphs.text: Dyane Paris aspires to bring French craftsmanship into dialogue with new forms of artistic expression.
Through porcelain, mixology and creative collaborations, our House seeks to contribute to a vision of French luxury that is contemporary, exacting and attached to its crafts.
This approach has a particular resonance with our invitation, on 14 December 2026, to the Grand Prix du Rayonnement Français by Her Royal Highness Princess Yasmine Murat.
An invitation in keeping with our wish to share, beyond our borders, the creativity of the artisans, producers and talents who contribute to Dyane Paris’s identity.
